name: slime-escape
description: Top-down arena shooter where a human escapes a world of slimes

scripts.build: npm run content:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit
